The actual Qt recording uses synthetic QDropEvent source() to supply the source TabBar and instruments QDrag.exec_ to record offers/return IgnoreAction. The native Qt OS drag loop, cancellation/drop routing and cross-window behavior are not recorded.

The native persistent in-window TouchArea supports page-tab reorder/nested transfer. OS QDrag pixmap/cursor, cross-window/tree drag, media/file/external drops and empty-notebook content-body drop remain outside this scope.

Approval combines the visible terminal consumer with source and executed assertion evidence, not geometry/skin equivalence.
